Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality FINAL DESIGN REVIEW screenshot for 虾传 / SHRIMPSEND, an extremely simple cross-platform device-to-device file and text transfer application. Single desktop app screen 1600 x 1100. Date anchor September 21, 2026. Chinese UI, beautifully typeset PingFang SC / Inter, exact sharp text, no watermark, no mockup perspective, no browser or OS chrome. Reference image is the OLD ROUGH implementation only: retain device-centric conversation and green brand recognition but COMPLETELY refine scale, spacing, hierarchy, controls and icon style. Do not imitate its oversize sidebar rows or blank chat.

Art direction: refined quiet professional utility, porcelain white #FBFCFB, very pale warm gray #F3F4F1 secondary sidebar, ink #202823, emerald #20735C only for primary action / tiny status / progress. Elegant small shrimp-shaped logomark, monochrome emerald, beside 虾传 wordmark. 1.5px consistent Lucide-like line icons. Typography at realistic 14-16 px, labels 12, section titles 22, only a few weights. Uniform 8px buttons, 12px surfaces, hairline dividers, almost no shadows; no gradients, decorative illustrations, dashboard metrics, arbitrary pills, neon or huge rounded cards. Carefully optical alignment, concise UI copy. Product should feel crafted like a premium native desktop utility.
Layout: 72px narrow left icon rail with shrimp logo top, 3 items labeled 传输 / 文件 / 设置, settings bottom. 264px pale sidebar with heading 设备 and compact plus button 连接设备. Search field 搜索设备. Device rows 72px tall with fine hardware icon, friendly name, one line status; selected 我的 MacBook subtle green-gray wash, others 办公室电脑 online, iPhone nearby, 家里的电脑 offline. Bottom 本机 · 浏览器, small green dot, no account avatar or upsell.
Main header white height80: hardware icon, 我的 MacBook, subtitle 已连接 · 局域网; search and more at right. Main conversation centered max width 860; date 今天 14:20. Received short left text “这是今天的项目资料。” in muted light grey, outgoing right text “收到，我把设计文件也传给你。” subtly green. Left clean compact received file row card with document icon “项目说明.pdf” 2.4 MB · 已保存, understated 打开 / 在文件夹中显示 actions. Right outgoing file card “品牌设计.fig” 28.6 MB · 已发送. Below larger active outgoing transfer card with minimal thumbnail/icon “产品演示.mov” 1.28 GB, 68% emerald thin progress, “86 MB/s · 约 5 秒”, pause and cancel small icons. Data plausible 870MB/1.28GB. Bottom fixed composer width860 height112 with unobtrusive outline, placeholder 写点什么，或拖入文件, bottom-left attachment button 文件 and image icon, bottom-right solid emerald 发送. Below composer muted microcopy “接收到 下载 文件夹” with folder link. Show normal app not explanatory annotations. NO permanent member status on main screen, no protocol menus. Use negative space intentionally without giant emptiness. Make the whole screenshot highly polished, usable and visually balanced.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished high-fidelity UI DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for 虾传 Shrimpsend. This is ONE coherent product design direction, not alternative ideas. Use the attached new approved-for-exploration main design as the visual system reference; match its emerald shrimp logo, porcelain white surfaces, subtle warm grey navigation, dark ink typography, restrained #20735C emerald accents, consistent 1.5px outline icons, 8px buttons, 12px card corners. Improve precision further: restrained realistic font sizes, excellent optical alignment, lots of calm negative space, hairline separators, no oversize boxes, no gratuitous shadows or gradients. This is a full app design suite, each frame must be a separate fully composed realistic screen with its own meaningful page content; NOT just text inventory or labeled blank placeholders. Board background pale #E9ECE8. Chinese PingFang SC / Inter typography, legible and correctly spelled. Small top board title, numbered frame titles outside screens. All exact UI labels below Chinese, perfectly typeset. Date anchor 2026-09-21, examples only. No OS chrome, phone frames, browser chrome, perspective, charts or decorative illustrations. Device transfer does not require account login. Connection pairing is DISTINCT from 6-character membership authorization. No account-sync claims. File downloads save directly to Downloads or chosen directory. Protocol options belong only to advanced settings. Never add marketing membership prompts to daily transfer screens. Each frame should focus on its own purpose, normally one primary CTA, no feature inventory.
BOARD TITLE “01 / 连接设备”. Canvas 2880 x 2160, FOUR desktop screens in precise 2 x 2 grid, each about 1320 x 920 with generous outer spacing. Match same rail/nav in all.
Top-left “初次打开”: sidebar 设备 empty with 连接设备 top. Main heading “把文件传到另一台设备” medium 28px, concise “无需登录，同一网络也能离线互传。” Below two nearby device rows “我的 MacBook” and “iPhone” with subtle platform outline icons, subtitle 同一网络, each 连接 button, main action “连接其他设备”; avoid huge empty cartoon.
Top-right “连接设备”: app background very gently dimmed, crisp 600px wide modal with title 连接设备, tabs 附近设备 / 连接码 / 扫码. Connection-code selected, label 对方的连接码, single full-width text field with realistic long pairing code “P7K2-M9Q4”, main “继续”, link 显示我的连接码. Small note 两台设备都需要确认后才能互传. This code is NOT the 6 character membership code.
Bottom-left “扫码连接”: modal title “让另一台设备扫一扫”, elegantly centered visual demo QR with small logo, below label “我的 MacBook”, pairing code “P7K2-M9Q4” copy icon, small 正在等待另一台设备, secondary 改用连接码. QR graphic is design mock only.
Bottom-right “确认连接”: modal title “连接这台设备？”, target iPhone outline icon, device name “iPhone”, platform “iOS · 同一网络”, verification digits “42 68” in a grouped monospaced callout. Copy “请核对两台设备上的数字是否一致。” At bottom secondary 取消, primary 确认连接. Behind modal show clean devices sidebar.
Screens should look like polished product screenshots, same sizing and weight conventions as reference, aligned fields, realistic fine controls, not diagram cards.

BOARD TITLE “02 / 文件与搜索”. Canvas 2880 x 2160. FOUR desktop screenshots, equal 2 x 2 grid. Use consistent app rail 传输 / 文件 / 设置, files selected.
A “文件管理”: thin header 文件 with search at right. Slim second sidebar 本机文件 / 云端文件, 最近接收 selected, 图片, 视频, 文档, 收藏; small footer 下载 文件夹. Content heading 最近接收, light segmented 全部 / 图片 / 视频 / 文档. Elegant table with icon+名称, 大小, 来源, 接收时间; rows 项目说明.pdf 2.4MB 我的MacBook 今天14:20, 产品演示.mov 1.28GB 办公室电脑 今天14:16, 品牌设计.fig 28.6MB iPhone 昨天. One selected row, quiet contextual toolbar 打开 / 发送到设备 / 在文件夹中显示. No cache metrics or cloud claims.
B “全局搜索”: heading 搜索, generous refined search field containing “项目”, tabs 全部 / 文字 / 文件, small filter 所有设备. Results grouped 今天 / 昨天. A highlighted text excerpt “这是今天的项目资料。” with source 我的MacBook and time; clean compact file result 项目说明.pdf; 项目计划.xlsx. Search hit highlighting muted green, not neon. Right context action 在会话中查看. Search across locally available history, not account sync.
C “文件预览”: wide understated header 项目说明.pdf with back arrow, file size, icons for download / send / more. Content paper page inside faint warm-gray preview background; simple realistic designed PDF page titled “项目说明” and subtitle “虾传 · 产品资料”, overview paragraph and three section headings, readable Chinese placeholder prose; page controls “1 / 8” bottom. Right narrow detail area 文件信息 lists2.4 MB, 来源我的MacBook, 保存位置 下载/项目说明.pdf, 接收时间今天14:20. Main action 打开文件夹.
D “选择文件发送”: elegant file selection dialog on chat background, left sources 文件 / 照片 / 最近项目, main file list with checkboxes, selected 项目说明.pdf and 品牌设计.fig, total “已选 2 个文件 · 31 MB”, recipient capsule “发送到 我的 MacBook”, bottom 取消 / 发送 2 个文件. Include a small selected-file tray and remove affordances. Make send-to-target explicit and easy.

BOARD TITLE “03 / 本机授权”. Canvas 2880 x 2160, four equal desktop screens in 2x2 grid. Consistent settings shell: app rail with 设置 active, slim sidebar grouped 本机设置 / 本机授权 / 会员与名额 / 账号 / 帮助. 本机授权 selected. These are device-side flows WITHOUT account login, no fake login avatar.
A “输入授权码”: content max680px, breadcrumb 设置 / 本机授权. Heading 本机授权, small text 无需登录，让这台设备获得会员服务. A compact current-device row 我的MacBook · 免费设备. A clean six-character grouped entry “K7M 8Q2”, label 六位授权码. One primary 授权本机, secondary 扫码授权, tertiary 从图片识别. Tiny note 六位码提交后，需由购买者确认. Footer 已有会员账号？管理设备名额. Do not use huge card within card.
B “扫码后核对”: medium modal on same settings shell, title 授权这台设备, hardware icon 我的MacBook, service 有效期随会员权益, masked source “m***@example.com”, main 授权本机, secondary 取消. Small warning 这不会登录购买账号或同步文件. No QR-to-login metaphor.
C “等待购买者确认”: same full-page shell, small neutral progress circle, heading 等待购买者确认, device summary 我的MacBook · macOS, code K7M 8Q2, remaining 09:42. Copy 请让生成授权码的人确认这台设备. Small outlined 撤销申请. Calm waiting state without giant spinner.
D “授权成功”: fine check icon in pale green small square, heading 本机已授权, device summary 我的MacBook, row 服务状态 已启用, 授权来源 m***@example.com, 有效期 2027年9月21日. Primary 返回传输, tertiary 管理授权. Brief 已授权的设备无需保持账号登录. No absurd success confetti, no financial price, no claim unlimited file bandwidth. Fine labels and ample spacing.

BOARD TITLE “04 / 会员与设备名额”. 2880 x 2160 canvas, 2 x 2 equally sized desktop screenshots. Settings rail has 传输 and 文件 at top, 设置 anchored bottom. Settings secondary nav 本机设置 / 本机授权 / 会员与名额 selected / 账号 / 帮助. ONE quiet primary action per frame. Never imply buying membership syncs files, never promise unlimited relay bandwidth. A “会员概览”: heading 会员与设备名额; concise 只需一个账号购买，设备各自独立使用. Tasteful flat pale green membership summary horizontal band: “设备服务包”, “已授权 2 / 6 台”, “有效期至 2027.09.21”, small 续费 / 订单记录 text actions. Prominent primary “生成授权码”. Below clean rows 我的MacBook / iPhone, last active 今天14:20 / 今天13:56, 授权状态 已授权, 解除授权 text. Bottom understated note 本机目前未授权 and secondary 授权本机, since billing login alone doesn't license this install.
B “生成授权码”: centered modal, title 授权另一台设备, demo QR small left, large mono spaced “K7M 8Q2” right, 复制授权码, 有效期 09:59. Below tiny text 用目标设备扫码或输入授权码, table 已预留1个名额 / 剩余可用3个. Small warning 输入六位码后请回来确认设备. Footer 撤销授权码 and 完成.
C “购买端确认”: settings page with small pending row and focus modal title 确认授权这台设备？. A laptop outline, 办公室电脑, Windows, 设备标识 · 7F2A. Copy 确认后将占用1个会员名额. Positive 权益授权不会建立文件传输连接. Buttons 拒绝 / 确认授权. No intrusive red.
D “购买与订单”: content heading 选择设备服务包. Simple horizontal selector “3 台 / 6 台 / 12 台”, 6台 selected, billing 月付 / 年付. Below clear list 正常使用不限信令次数, 授权设备免登录使用, 原有授权随续费延续. Price area text “价格以结算页为准” because pricing not being decided in design. Primary 前往结算. Under divider 订单记录 with a realistic previous row 设备服务包 · 6台 · 年付 / 2026.09.21 / 已完成 / 查看详情, no money. Tiny note 文件直传不人为限速；中转服务另按实际权益说明. Focus on clarity not aggressive pricing cards.

BOARD TITLE “05 / 首次使用与账号”. 2880 x 2160 four equal desktop screenshots 2x2. Keep warm restrained proportions from reference. No people, no marketing illustrations.
A “首次使用”: full white welcome screen with small shrimp wordmark top left. Main left-center heading “从这台设备开始” and description “传文件、发文字，无需先注册。” Form label 设备名称 with “我的 MacBook”; selection 语言 简体中文 / 服务区域 中国大陆. Hint 服务区域仅用于选择在线服务. Primary 开始使用. Small unobtrusive links 隐私政策 / 使用条款 bottom; explicit unselected checkbox 我已阅读并同意使用条款与隐私政策 where legally needed, no forced account login or automatic agreement.
B “登录购买账号”: centered narrow 400px elegant form, back 返回传输 top left, shrimp small above heading 登录账号, microcopy 用于购买会员和管理设备名额. Fields 邮箱, 密码 with eye, subtle 忘记密码 link. Primary 登录, bottom 没有账号？注册. Footer 只想传文件？免登录使用. No third-party social buttons unless needed.
C “注册账号”: same composition as login, heading 创建账号, small 仅需在购买会员时注册. Fields 邮箱, 验证码 with 获取验证码 small inline button, 密码 with subtle password hint. Explicit unselected agreement checkbox and linked 使用条款 / 隐私政策. Primary 创建账号, 已有账号？登录 and 返回免登录使用 below. Never make checkbox look preaccepted.
D “账号管理”: settings shell identical to reference (72px icon rail, 220px text sidebar) with 账号 active. Heading 账号, simple profile row circle M “m***@example.com” 已验证, no photos. Group 账号信息 with nickname 我的账号 and 修改, 邮箱 and 更换. Group 安全 with 修改密码, 登录会话. Group 会员与名额 with 管理设备服务. Bottom 退出账号 outlined; tiny line 退出账号不会解除本机授权或删除本地文件. Dangerous 注销账号 visually quiet link with a separator, no broad red card.

BOARD TITLE “06 / 设置基础”. Four desktop frames in 2x2 on 2880x2160. ALL FOUR use EXACT SAME settings shell: narrow 72px vertical rail with shrimp logo, 传输, 文件 and bottom 设置; separate 220px sidebar headed 设置 listing 本机设置 / 本机授权 / 会员与名额 / 账号 / 帮助. 本机设置 highlighted. DO NOT invent other main rail entries. Content column max720px with heading and short subnav 通用 / 接收与保存 / 外观 / 语言 / 字体 / 快捷键, corresponding tab selected per frame. Navigation must be identical across all four.
A “通用设置”: heading 本机设置, description 仅影响这台设备. Label 设备名称 field 我的MacBook with inline 修改. Fine divided rows 开机启动 toggle on; 收到文件时通知 toggle on; 自动复制收到的文字 toggle off; 接收前确认 dropdown 陌生设备需要确认; 高级连接设置 collapsed disclosure. Small current-device footer 未登录 · 已授权. No pointless repeated links list.
B “接收与保存”: heading 接收与保存. Primary location row folder icon “下载” and path “~/Downloads”, button 更改位置. Below two vertically stacked radio rows 系统下载目录 selected; 自定义文件夹. Elegant divided settings 同名文件 保留两个文件, 图片保存到相册 toggle off, 接收完成后通知 on. Calm note 文件直接保存到这里，不额外保留副本. Footer web-specific info 浏览器不支持指定文件夹时，将使用浏览器的下载设置. Must acknowledge web constraints, no promise all browsers can choose.
C “外观”: heading 外观, three carefully rendered miniature previews 120x90px of same app shell, labels 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统, 跟随系统 selected by thin emerald border and small check. Below 缩放比例 100% dropdown, 减少动画 toggle follows system, compact live sample with 文件传输 preview/progress. No gradients and no aesthetic color selector inventory.
D “语言与区域”: heading 语言与区域. App语言 segmented 简体中文 / English, 简体中文 selected. Region field 中国大陆 and helper 用于选择在线服务，离线传输不受影响. Date format preview “2026年9月21日 14:20”, file size 128 MB. Changing region confirmation small inset modal lower-right “切换服务区域？” copy 将重新连接在线服务，本地文件保留, 取消 / 切换. Keep nontechnical end-user wording.
